<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 2">Num. R. s. 2</cite> (play on <he>ודגלו</he>, <cite ref="Song of Songs 2:4">Cant. II, 4</cite>) <he>ודִילּוּגוֹ עלי וכ׳</he> even his skipping from subject to subject is to me a token of love. Cant. R. to l. c. (ref. to a child’s skipping over the Name of the Lord in reading exercises and to an ignorant person’s misreading); Yalk. ib. 986.
